display.title: Episode 15: The Miracle of Toras Emes, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: The wicked officer's plot to shame the Jews before the king unravels when the rabbi dreams three times of a true Torah. Plus Shema in Studio 604 and the grand contest winners.
display.summary_long: The week after Purim 5742. After the opening march, Uncle Yossi recaps the story: the jealous officer Yivan persuaded Chaim the shamash to prepare an empty, make-believe Sefer Torah for the king's visit. A young Tzivos Hashem member leads the Shema in Studio 604. In the concluding chapter, the town prepares a royal welcome while Yivan tells the king that the Jews are fooling him and urges him to look under the velvet cover; the king warns Yivan that his life is at stake if the charge is false. The night before the visit, the rabbi hears a voice in his dream three times calling 'Toras emes, a true Torah', checks the shul, and replaces the empty scroll with a real Sefer Torah. Uncle Yossi compares the miracle to Purim: in the merit of Jewish children learning Torah, Hashem protects His people, in those days and in our time, and will bring Moshiach. He then dives into the mailbox to draw the winners of the grand contest, explains how to join Tzivos Hashem, and offers song sheets for 'We Want Moshiach Now'.
display.lesson: In the merit of Jewish children learning Torah and doing mitzvos, Hashem protects His people, in those days and in our time.
